_about: Permanent register of every published Practice Library card. The practice-library.html page merges this file with the live Substack section feed — the feed shows the newest cards automatically, this file keeps every card visible after it falls off the feed window. This is also the provenance record: one entry per card, version-controlled, dated. Add an entry INSIDE the cards array as part of publishing each card. See data/README.md.
